sections.heading: Move effects
lines: Double Iron Bash, Flash Cannon, Gear Grind, Gyro Ball, and Magnet Bomb: 2× stronger.
Spin Out, Steamroller, and Techno Blast: 1.5× stronger.

sections.heading: Standard moves and typing
lines: Mimicry and Camouflage turn Pokémon Steel-type.
Secret Power can lower the target's Attack.

sections.heading: Changes and restoration
lines: Aura Wheel, Bulldoze, Discharge, Earthquake, Explosion, Fissure, Gigavolt Havoc, Ion Deluge, Light That Burns the Sky, Magnitude, Overdrive, Self-Destruct, and Tectonic Rage change the field into Short-Circuit.

sections.heading: Abilities
lines: Heavy Metal: Defense +1 and Speed −1 when it enters.
Light Metal: Speed +1 when it enters.

sections.heading: Seed
lines: Synthetic Seed: Special Attack +1 and focuses.

sections.heading: More
lines: Rarer interactions of specific moves, abilities and items follow the Rejuvenation field rules and are not all listed here.
